Why are AI agents so hard to evaluate, and what makes a benchmark trustworthy? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, John Yang, co-creator of SWE-bench, introduces a 4-tuple framework for agent evaluation (request, environment, stopping criteria, and scorer), how to design each component, the properties of good benchmarks, realistic scaffolding, and the dimensions of agent reliability.
Key questions answered in this lecture:
Q: Why is it hard to evaluate AI agents?
